title: Works Great!
text: Works Great!. These are sturdy lazy Susan turntables. I am very impressed with the quality. We have one on the kitchen counter with olive oil, vinegar, salt, and other frequently used items. The other is in the pantry and is holding hot sauces. They spin well. The sides/edges are at a good height that things don't get knocked off when spinning. I am pleased with them.

product_metadata.title: Clear Lazy Susan Organizer Bin-360 Rotating Turntable Container-Plastic Tray for Cabinet, Table, Spice Rack, Pantry, Refrigerator-Perfect for Spice, Makeup, Condiments, Food, Cosmetic
features: ✿【No more digging in the back】With our rotated organizer, you do not need to concern about digging to get an item from the back of the shelf though you have lots of odds and ends of items. Our lazy susan organizers can be spined, and is always visible, allow you see everything you have and reach eaily. Perfect fit for kitchen, cabinet, pantry, bathroom, bedroom, shelf countertop, vanity to keep things tidy.

✿【Perfect storage size】The diameter of our acrylic lazy susan bin is 9". Large capacity for storing in the kitchen. Ideal for seasoning, spices, cans, cooking supplies, balsamic vinegars, spicy bottles, medicine, condiments, jars, cosmetic and napkins.
✿【Flexibly rotated】The 360°rotated design makes round container spin well. Just need little force, then it can spin smoothly. Rotating design makes it easier for you to access any items you can see.
✿【Securely storage】The 3.1" high raise rim prevents bottled stuff from falling off. High enough so things don’t fall out. Friendly to tall bottles, like wine and vinegars bottles.
✿【Nice quality】Made of durable BPA free.Clear material and Chlorine free shatter-resistant plastic. Our lazy susan turntable organizer is food safe and can be cleaned easily with mild soap and water.
